title: Measure and mark
description: An overhead study of a maker using a ruler and pencil to mark a sheet of timber on a well-used workbench. A silent woodworking short. Footage by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels.

title: Sand the surface
description: A close-up study of a maker smoothing a clamped timber board with an orbital sander. A silent woodworking short. Footage by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels.

title: Fill the grain
description: A close-up study of a maker spreading wood filler across a clamped board with a small putty knife. A silent woodworking short. Footage by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels.

title: Square the board
description: A maker checks a pale timber board with a large metal framing square before marking a cut. A woodworking short. Footage by Everett Bumstead on Pexels.

title: Check the edge
description: A craftsperson works a narrow timber piece along a benchtop machine, then lifts it to inspect the edge. A woodworking short. Footage by Burak Bahadır Büyükkılınç on Pexels.

title: Across the table saw
description: Close views follow a timber panel moving past the spinning blade of a table saw. A woodworking short. Footage by cottonbro studio on Pexels.

title: At the assembly bench
description: Gloved hands use pliers on a small wooden assembly, with a hammer and timber strips laid out nearby. A woodworking short. Footage by Kaboompics on Pexels.

title: Plane a clean face
description: A craftsperson guides an electric planer along a timber board as fresh shavings scatter across the bench. A woodworking short. Footage by Burak Bahadır Büyükkılınç on Pexels.

title: Polish the curve
description: A craftsperson turns a curved wooden piece against a spinning workshop polishing wheel. A woodworking short. Footage by Burak Bahadır Büyükkılınç on Pexels.

title: Drill at the workbench
description: A maker uses a cordless drill on timber pieces at a workbench filled with clamps and hand tools. A woodworking short. Footage by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels.

title: Shape the edge
description: A craftsperson works the edge of an upright wooden piece clamped above a sawdust-covered bench. A woodworking short. Footage by Burak Bahadır Büyükkılınç on Pexels.

title: Brush away the dust
description: A maker brushes dust from a freshly worked board, then lifts the timber to inspect its surface. A woodworking short. Footage by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels.

title: Guide the cut
description: A woodworker guides a board through a table saw and checks the work from the end of the bench. A woodworking short. Footage by cottonbro studio on Pexels.

title: Cut to length
description: A maker lowers a powered miter saw through a board, then lifts the saw after the cut. A woodworking short. Footage by Everett Bumstead on Pexels.

title: Smooth a round seat
description: A maker works around the rim of a round wooden seat with a handheld power sander. A woodworking short. Footage by Anna Shvets on Pexels.

title: Follow the grain
description: Close-up views follow an orbital sander moving over the rough face of a thick timber piece. A woodworking short. Footage by Everett Bumstead on Pexels.

title: A steady sanding pass
description: A maker wearing hearing protection and a dust mask guides an orbital sander across a timber board. A woodworking short. Footage by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels.

title: Shavings by hand
description: A maker pushes a hand plane along a clamped board at a crowded woodworking bench. A woodworking short. Footage by Tima Miroshnichenko on Pexels.
